News alerts: past injury history and the word 'running back' no longer turn good news red (Dom, Nov 25: ACTION light red)

'Jonah Coleman is the AFC offensive player of the week' was a red act-now card on Dom's DK III starter
because the story's body said he moved up 'since returning from injured reserve' and called him a
running back (read as a back injury). Injury words about something already over are now cut before the
bad/caution check, 'running back' is treated as a position, and honors (player of the week, career high)
count as good news. The card is now grey and the ACTION light clears.
